@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import _ from 'lodash';
+
+describe('probe lodash meanBy', () => {
+  it('prints', () => {
+    const cases: Array<[string, any]> = [
+      ['1 basic', _.meanBy([{ a: 1 }, {}], 'a')],
+      ['2 mixed undefined', _.meanBy([{ a: 1 }, { a: undefined }, { a: 3 }], 'a')],
+      ['3 identity undefined', _.meanBy([1, undefined, 2])],
+      ['4 nested path', _.meanBy([{ a: { b: 1 } }, {}], 'a.b')],
+      ['5 all undefined', _.meanBy([{}, {}], 'a')],
+      ['6 null value', _.meanBy([{ a: 1 }, { a: null }], 'a')],
+      ['7 empty', _.meanBy([], 'a')],
+      ['8 empty arraylike', _.meanBy({ length: 0 } as any, 'a')],
+      ['9 all null', _.meanBy([{ a: null }, { a: null }], 'a')],
+      ['10 null iteratee', _.meanBy([{ a: 1 }, {}], null)],
+      ['11 sum of undefined', _.sum([1, undefined, 2])],
+      ['12 mean undefined', _.mean([1, undefined, 2])],
+      ['13 arraylike', _.meanBy({ 0: { a: 1 }, 1: {}, length: 2 } as any, 'a')],
+      ['14 bool', _.meanBy([{ a: true }, { a: false }], 'a')],
+      ['15 string nums', _.meanBy([{ a: '1' }, { a: '3' }], 'a')],
+      ['16 fn iteratee undef', _.meanBy([1, undefined, 2], v => v)],
+      ['17 Infinity', _.meanBy([{ a: Infinity }, { a: 1 }], 'a')],
+      ['18 NaN', _.meanBy([{ a: NaN }, { a: 1 }], 'a')],
+      ['19 single undef', _.meanBy([{ a: undefined }], 'a')],
+      ['20 undef first then num', _.meanBy([{ a: undefined }, { a: 2 }], 'a')],
+    ];
+    for (const [name, result] of cases) {
+      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
+      console.log(name, '=>', String(result), typeof result === 'number' ? `(NaN? ${Number.isNaN(result)})` : '');
+    }
+    expect(true).toBe(true);
+  });
+});

+/**
+ * Checks if a property key is unsafe to write to.
+ *
+ * Writing through `__proto__`, `constructor`, or `prototype` can reach
+ * `Object.prototype` and pollute every object, so write paths like `set`,
+ * `update`, and `zipObjectDeep` abort when a path segment matches one of
+ * these keys, matching lodash's behavior.
+ *
+ * Read paths like `get` and `unset` use `isUnsafeProperty` instead, which
+ * only blocks `__proto__`; lodash keeps reads of `constructor` and
+ * `prototype` unrestricted.
+ *
+ * @param key - The property key to check
+ * @returns `true` if the property is unsafe to write to, `false` otherwise
+ * @internal
+ */
+export function isUnsafeToWriteProperty(key: PropertyKey) {
+  return key === '__proto__' || key === 'constructor' || key === 'prototype';
+}
